# Subschema fixtures

`openldap-2.6.ldif` is the raw `ldapsearch -LL` answer of a real OpenLDAP 2.6
server (Debian 13 `slapd` package) for its `cn=Subschema` entry, captured by
`tools/capture-subschema-fixture.ps1` with the same schema set the differential
CI job loads (core + cosine + inetorgperson). Unlike the vendored corpora, this
content is runtime-generated by slapd and cannot be fetched from the OpenLDAP
source tree; the capture script records the exact slapd version each run.

Never hand-edit; re-run the script to refresh. The definitions originate from
the OpenLDAP project — license text at `../openldap/LICENSE.OpenLDAP`.
